sn35.116:4.1: “Reverend Ānanda, the Buddha gave this brief summary recital, then entered his dwelling without explaining the meaning in detail:
sn35.116:4.2: ‘Mendicants, I say it’s not possible to know or see or reach the end of the world by traveling.
sn35.116:4.3: But I also say there’s no making an end of suffering without reaching the end of the world.’
sn35.116:4.4: Reverend, soon after the Buddha left, we considered,
sn35.116:4.5: ‘Reverends, the Buddha gave this brief summary recital, then entered his dwelling without explaining the meaning in detail—
sn35.116:4.6: Mendicants, I say it’s not possible to know or see or reach the end of the world by traveling.
sn35.116:4.7: But I also say there’s no making an end of suffering without reaching the end of the world.
sn35.116:4.8: Who can explain in detail the meaning of this brief summary recital given by the Buddha?’
sn35.116:4.10: ‘Reverends, this Venerable Ānanda is praised by the Buddha and esteemed by his sensible spiritual companions.
sn35.116:4.11: He is capable of explaining in detail the meaning of this brief summary recital given by the Buddha.
sn35.116:4.12: Let’s go to him, and ask him about this matter.’
sn35.116:5.4: He is vision, he is knowledge, he is the manifestation of principle, he is the manifestation of divinity. He is the preacher, the proclaimer, the elucidator of meaning, the bestower of freedom from death, the lord of truth, the Realized One.
